events.name: 8 Mile Rap Battle
events.description: On a packed underground club stage, you take the mic in the final battle of 8 Mile: arm up to the crowd, rapping into the mic, turning on your rival while the room goes wild.

events.name: Can I Help You, Miss?
events.description: You in a pet-store aisle, stretching for a giant bag of dog food on the top shelf, when the person filming heaves it onto your shoulder, then stacks a second giant bag on top: you glare into the camera under both and stagger off down the aisle.

events.name: Dog Flipping Pancakes
events.description: Your pet sits up beside the stove watching the cook fry a pancake, springs up, takes the pan off them and flips the pancake itself, then stands up on its hind legs and celebrates.

events.name: Drunk Santa
events.description: You and Santa stagger arm in arm out of a bar on a night sidewalk, bottles swinging, lurch against a lamppost and dive head first into a wheelie bin, legs kicking, in one handheld take.

events.name: Hold Up Dance
events.description: You do the Hold Up Dance in a small room: a kick step in, arm swings across the chest, hard arm whips and side kicks, a deep squat with both hands on your head, a hard bend to one side, then down on one knee with your arms crossed, one full-length take.

events.name: Loving Every Minute Dance
events.description: You, or you and two friends, in matching white football kits on a beige studio set: the one in the middle counts the Brazilian charme steps into the camera, then all three dance side to side to "Lovin' Every Minute" and finish with open palms to the lens.

events.name: Ninja Cat
events.description: Your pet stands on its back legs on a night highway curb in a black ski mask, holding a selfie stick, then pulls the mask down to show its face while cars pass behind, and shakes the hood off at the end.

events.name: Peak 2027
events.description: You climb the last snowy rocks of a mountain with a giant stone 7 on your back, shove the 6 of a huge stone 2026 off the summit, heave the 7 into its place and stand there as the sky turns to a golden sunrise and the numbers read 2027.

events.name: Scooter Puddle Splash
events.description: You two become the lanky clay couple on the little green scooter: the driver steers, the one behind sits arms folded, and you bump through muddy puddles down a street of pink and cream houses until the one behind bounces right off the seat.

events.name: Shiba Barber Dance
events.description: Your pet sits in a black barber chair, the barber whips the striped cape off, and it springs out onto its hind legs, dances upright with the barber across the shop, then dodges their grab and leaps out of the open door.

events.name: Two Shots of Vodka Meme
events.description: You as the TV cooking-show host who calls for "two shots of vodka", then tips the bottle fully upside down into the shaker, before the meme cuts to a man staggering drunk along a trailer wall.

events.name: Wassup Been a Minute Dance
events.description: You and up to two friends on a misty green hillside above a Swiss lake, doing the Wassup Been a Minute dance: hands-on-head bounces, a close-up full of hand moves, a walk toward the camera and a wide shot dancing across the slope.

events.name: Yes Tokyo Dance
events.description: You dancing the Yes! Tokyo routine on your own in a bright dance studio: arms swung wide, a finger pointed at the sky, bouncy knee-bent steps and low lunges, hands on your head, and both arms thrown up to finish.
